summary: The HDFS Engineer manages and optimizes Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performance data storage.
responsibilities: Design and manage HDFS storage architecture
Monitor and optimize data replication and availability
Implement backup, recovery, and security controls
Ensure high availability of NameNode services
Collaborate with Hadoop and infrastructure teams

education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field
4–7 years of HDFS and Hadoop storage experience

skills_required.name: Strong Linux and system administration skills
Knowledge of Hadoop security and access controls
